notes: Catalogue clean-up, part 2: 209 more listings removed where two trims of the same car look identical in real life (same body, doors and size, sold in the same years, differing only in trim, engine or drivetrain - e.g. LX/EX, TDI, 4MATIC, 2.0 vs 2.5). The newest stays and keeps all the engines. Versions with their own bodywork (M, RS, AMG kits, GTI, Type R, Shelby, 4x4, cross/active, coupes, cabrios, other cabs and door counts) stay as separate cars. Owned cars are unaffected.
